noChrome.macTitle: macOS is hiding your Chrome profiles
noChrome.macBody: Chrome's data folder is privacy-protected. Grant Full Disk Access to Godmode in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Full Disk Access, then retry. Cookies are only read locally — nothing leaves this machine.
noChrome.openSettingsFailed: Open System Settings → Privacy & Security manually.
noChrome.noneTitle: No Chrome profiles found on this machine
noChrome.supported: Google Chrome, Chromium, Edge, Brave and Helium are supported.

toast.runningDescription: Live view connects in a moment.
toast.defaultFailed: Could not change the default profile
toast.agentsBrowse: {{scope}}'s agents browse with it from their next run.

workspaceField.label: Browser profile
workspaceField.moving: {{name}} moves into this workspace. Agents elsewhere that picked it keep using it.
workspaceField.hint: The workspace's agents browse with this profile, unless an agent picks its own.

page.title: Browser
page.description: Godmode's own Chromium profiles. Agents browse here — signed in with the sessions you import — and you can watch or take over at any time.
page.emptyDescription: Create a profile to give your agents a browser. The core normally creates a default one on start.

assign.title: Assign “{{name}}” to a workspace
assign.description: Cookies and sessions stay with the profile. Agents that picked it in their own settings keep using it wherever they are.
assign.globalHint: Not tied to a workspace; agents use it when they pick it
assign.noProfile: No profile yet — agents browse with {{name}}
assign.noWorkspaces: No workspaces yet — create one per client or project to keep their sessions apart.
assign.noProfileYet: {{name}} has no profile yet, so its agents browse with this one unless they pick their own.
assign.replaces: Replaces {{name}} as the browser its agents use, unless they pick their own.
assign.leaving: {{workspace}}'s agents will browse with {{profile}} instead, unless you make another of its profiles the default.

chip.title: Browser profile
chip.description: Runs in this chat browse with this profile's cookies and logins.

profileUse.title: browser-use Cloud sync
profileUse.description: Syncs your local Chrome cookies to a browser-use Cloud profile so cloud agents are logged in too.
profileUse.notAvailable: Not available in this version of the core.
profileUse.takesMinutes: This can take a few minutes — you can keep working meanwhile.

list.deleteBody: The browser profile and everything in it — cookies, sessions, history, local storage — is removed from this machine. Agents assigned to this profile will need another one. This can't be undone.
list.defaultTooltip: New chats browse here unless their workspace has its own default
list.agentTooltip: Created empty by an agent for itself or its team; agents may assign it
list.createdDescription: Launch it or import your Chrome sessions next.
list.newDescription: A separate Chromium with its own cookies and logins — e.g. one per client or workspace, so sessions never mix.
list.availableHint: Agents pick their profile in their settings; workspace profiles are offered to that workspace's agents.

import.title: Import sessions
import.description: Continue where Chrome left off — copy your logged-in sessions so agents don't have to sign in again.
import.jsonFooter: You can also import a cookie export in the “Cookies JSON” tab.
import.domainsPlaceholder: Leave empty to import every site — or type a domain and press Enter
import.keychain: On macOS you may see a Keychain prompt — allow access so Godmode can decrypt Chrome cookies. Cookies stay on this machine and are only copied into {{name}}.
import.signedIn: Agents using this profile are now signed in to these sites.
import.tooLarge: Cookie files larger than 20 MB aren't supported.
import.jsonHint: Paste cookies exported by <mono>profile-use</mono>, a cookie-editor extension or a Playwright <mono>storage_state</mono> file — or drop the file here.

live.inControl: You're in control — clicks, scrolling and typing go to the page. Turn off Take over when you're done.
live.chatTab: This chat's own tab — other chats browse in theirs. Take over to solve CAPTCHAs or log in manually.
live.agentsWorking: Agents keep working in this browser — take over to solve CAPTCHAs or log in manually.
live.viewportControl: Remote browser — keyboard and mouse input is forwarded
live.clickForKeyboard: Click the page to send keyboard input
live.notRunningBody: Agents start it automatically when they need the web. Launch it now to watch, log in manually or check your imported sessions.
live.noTabTitle: No page open in this chat
live.noTabBody: The agent opens its own tab when it needs the web. Enter an address above to open one yourself.
live.stillNothing: Still nothing? Live view may be turned off in Settings → Browser, or the browser runs without a visible page yet.
